items.text: A strong concern at this entry's own ghost-form breaking, "a field observing returning properties that belong to count itself independently of substance, allotrope, oxidation state and conditions": inner X-ray lines shift by about 0.02 to 0.09 percent across compounds and an element's line pattern goes the same to about a part per million in a quasar at redshift 1.15 and here, while this entry already places reading Z as accounting; a cohering re-saying has an element's substance, chemistry and outer responses going with its bi-couplings, its inner lines and line pattern with its proton number, and mass and nuclear magnetism with a nuclide.

Sulfur's Kα₁ line, about 2.3 keV, moves about 2 eV from sulfide to sulfate, and iron's Kβ₁,₃, about 7,059 eV, 1.7 ± 0.5 eV between FeS and FeS₂; iron, magnesium, zinc and chromium lines toward HE 0515−4414 at redshift 1.15, 16.1 hours with ESPRESSO, give Δα/α = 1.3 ± 1.3 ± 0.4 parts per million; one electron bound to a bare carbon-12 nucleus gives the electron's mass to about 3 × 10⁻¹¹: inner lines and line patterns going with a proton number, and a particle's mass going the same, across compounds and across a quasar's distance, a concern for each element as a version of one atom/carbon.

In accelerator mass spectrometry nitrogen forms no stable negative ion, and the main isobar at mass 14 goes at the source, carbon-14 going ion by ion to a counter; carbon's 1s line spreads about 11 eV on about 285 eV across compounds, about 4 percent, diamond and graphite of one proton number are hard and insulating and soft and conducting, and sodium at about 200 GPa is a transparent insulator: an element's substance and outer responses going with its bi-couplings, and two proton numbers responding apart in a chemical response at one mass.

Each backbone link of DNA and RNA is a phosphodiester and ATP has three phosphates; GFAJ-1, read in 2010 as having arsenic in its DNA, Erb and others find in 2012 "arsenate-resistant, phosphate-dependent", Reaves and others finding no detectable arsenate in its DNA, and the journal retracts the 2010 paper in July 2025 on "flawed data"; twenty-one elements are essential for humans, chromium in dispute, sulfur in cysteine and methionine, iron at haem's centre and magnesium at chlorophyll's: carbon, oxygen, hydrogen and nitrogen about 96 percent of a body's mass and its scaffold, and phosphorus, sulfur and metals its partners in each cell a field records, a concern for no other elements in life.

Z-DNA is a left-handed double helix of 12 base pairs a turn, ADAR1's Zα domain binds it, and in mice ADAR1 restrains ZBP1, a sensor of left-handed Z-form nucleic acids, from switching on spontaneously; HIV-1 protease of D-amino acids folds into the mirror form and works on mirror substrates; sinistral Lymnaea carry a one-base deletion in the formin gene Lsdia1, its authors' strongest candidate; 92 percent of 1,485 twining stems are right-handed; a cucumber tendril forms a left and a right helix meeting at a perversion: a hand going on within a lineage, with a right bias in B-DNA and L-amino acids' alpha-helices, and no one universal right hand, D and L naming a configuration and not a spiral's hand.

H₂'s dissociation energy is 35,999.582894(25) cm⁻¹, to 7 × 10⁻¹⁰; ICN's break goes in about 200 fs; electron diffraction films CF₃I's carbon–iodine break; an AFM with a CO tip reads bond orders about 0.2 apart, its tip's tilt exaggerating lengths about elevenfold, and shows lines between two nitrogens with no bond, "cannot be directly interpreted": a between with an energy, a time course and a picture, and no bond object apart from electrons' and nuclei's density and energy, Living Ghost Registry 6.1's bond living.

SN 1987A's neutrinos, about 24 events in about 13 seconds, are a messenger other than light across about 170,000 light-years; the solar wind goes at about 300 to 800 km/s and coronal mass ejections reach Earth in 37 to 82 hours; at about 124 AU Voyager 1 records about 0.08 electrons per cm³ and a front going with a solar event a year earlier, its authors' possible trigger; IBEX measures interstellar helium coming in at about 26 km/s: changing going through sparse space slower than light through carriers, and a messenger other than light, a concern for only the light-prime rate, its second saying as a parity's rate with its breaking still to name, and a cohering re-saying c the limit for a changing with no carrier of mass.
